title: Toledo IV, Canon 57
old: Some had already been baptized under Sisebut. ‘Because it is now established that they have received the divine sacraments, the grace of baptism, the chrism and the body and blood of the Lord’, they must be made to keep the faith they took, ‘lest the name of the Lord be blasphemed and the faith be held vile’.
new: Some had already been baptized under Sisebut. They had shared in the divine sacraments, the canon says: they had received the grace of baptism, been anointed with the chrism and taken the body and blood of the Lord.
